# ghg.ccap

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- [![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Metropolitan-Council/ghg.ccap/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Metropolitan-Council/ghg.ccap/actions) -->
<!-- badges: end -->

*This project has been funded wholly or in part by the United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) under assistance agreement 00E03476 to the Metropolitan Council. The contents of this repository do not necessarily reflect the views and policies of the EPA, nor does the EPA endorse trade names or recommend the use of commercial products mentioned in this repository.*

The `{ghg.ccap}` repository contains data, code, and documentation for the Twin Cities Metropolitan Statistical Area's Comprehensive Climate Action Plan (CCAP) of the EPA's Climate Pollution Reduction Grant.

The CCAP will expand on previous Met Council Greenhouse Gas (GHG) inventories, ghg.cprg, ghg.sp, in several important ways.

1) expands to four additional collar counties. 
2) quantify agricultural sector emissions and natural land carbon sequestration.
3) develop a baseline year in line with the state of MN's efforts, 2005.
4) project GHG emission out to 2030 and 2050.
5) identifies additional emission reduction measures and quantifies there short and long-term emission reduction potential.
6) quantifies co-benefits to low income and disadvantaged communities as defined by the EPA

This repository was originally forked from ghg.sp and has the potential to ultimately update the strategy planing tool based on the expanded inventory items of the CCAP.

## Installation

Ensure your git credentials set up for accessing internal-only Council repositories.   

You can install the development version of `{ghg.ccap}` from [GitHub](https://github.com/Metropolitan-Council/ghg.ccap) with:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Metropolitan-Council/ghg.ccap")
```

`{ghg.ccap}` requires a few packages only available on GitHub. Install them separately

``` r
remotes::install_github("hadley/emo")
remotes::install_github("Metropolitan-Council/councilR")

```
